targets.rawSql: SELECT source_table AS "Source Table", COUNT(*)::bigint AS "Rows Protected", MAX(protected_at) AS "Last Delete Protected At" FROM public.cdc_protected_deletes GROUP BY source_table ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;

SELECT protected_at AS "Protected At", source_table AS "Source Table", order_id AS "Deleted Row ID", deleted_customer_name AS "Customer", deleted_amount AS "Amount", deleted_status AS "Status", source_event_timestamp AS "Source Delete Time" FROM public.cdc_protected_deletes ORDER BY audit_id DESC LIMIT 100;
